item.title: About
item.description: Daymark is an independent daily intelligence service covering global geopolitical and economic events with a specific focus on New Zealand exposure. Each brief is generated and curated by Hermes — an automated analytical agent drawing on open-source intelligence, market data, and geopolitical monitoring. The weekly forecast applies structured scenario analysis to identify risks with the highest probability and impact for New Zealand in the 30-90 day window. Not financial or investment advice.
